Ontology_ProcessingAndDifferential_promp.notes: This is a Chemical Cross-Linking Mass Spectrometry (CXMS) experiment. The primary objective is the identification of cross-linked peptides to validate the cryo-EM structure of the NALCN-FAM155A complex, not differential abundance analysis. Standard bottom-up pipelines must be modified to handle the specific mass shifts and connectivity of BS3 cross-links.
